premise: Deniz and Ada both reach for the last short red chalk piece to finish their separate courtyard roads and find a way to use it together.

beats.beat: Deniz draws a long blue road with yellow dashes in the courtyard while Ada draws her own road nearby, the two of them playing peacefully side by side.
Deniz decides his road needs a red stop sign at the end and opens the chalk box to find a red piece.
Just as Deniz reaches in, Ada's hand reaches for the box too, and both see there is only one short red chalk piece left inside.
Both grab it at the same time; Deniz says he needs red for his stop sign, Ada says she needs red for her fire truck, and they end up holding the same short piece at opposite ends, stuck.
They pause; Deniz looks at his road, then at Ada's road, and notices the two chalk roads almost touch in the middle.
Deniz suggests they draw the red part together: each of them holds one end of the short chalk and they make one big red circle right where the two roads meet.

Kneeling side by side, they push the chalk together and the wobbly red circle spreads over both roads; then they take turns with the same piece, Ada adding red wheels to her fire truck and Deniz adding a red stripe to his stop sign.
They sit back and look at the two roads joined by the big red circle, and Deniz places the short red chalk back into the chalk box between them.

assumptions.text: Ada is drawing her own road close enough to Deniz's road that the two chalk lines nearly touch.
assumptions.why_safe: Temporary layout of washable chalk drawings; adds no durable canon.

assumptions.text: Ada wants the red chalk for a fire truck on her road.

assumptions.text: Deniz wants the red chalk for a stop sign on his road.

proposed_state_changes.description: The short red chalk piece is slightly shorter from shared use and is returned to the chalk box.
Deniz and Ada end the scene still friends, having just shared the red chalk peacefully.

preserved_invariants: Ada is Deniz's friend; their most recent play had no conflict and no lasting damage occurs in this story.

No adult resolves the disagreement; Deniz and Ada resolve it themselves.
No new durable canon is created beyond the proposed state changes.
